text: Bravo, God, bravo! Gods and all angels shout, "Encore!"
in awe before God's visible power. Stand at attention! Dress your best to honor him!
Brilliant, his voice and his face, streaming brightness—God, across the flood waters.
The high ridges jump like wild kid goats.
He makes the desert of Kadesh shake.
A wild dance, whirling; the pelting rain strips their branches. We fall to our knees—we call out, "Glory!"
from which his power flows, from which he rules the world.
